performance_case.causal_mechanism: CCI scales completed-day typical-price displacement from its rolling mean by mean absolute deviation; crossing the positive extreme may identify strong directional demand while the symmetric negative extreme provides a broad reversal exit and hysteresis reduces threshold churn before next-open execution.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may establish only one pre-2025 historical Design and Validation decision for exact TA-Lib-formula-compatible CCI14 symmetric 75, 100 and 125 hysteresis thresholds with 100 primary. It cannot inspect post-2024 data, tune any formula or gate, substitute a neighbor, create Trading behavior, activate a strategy or open OOS unless every frozen gate passes.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: The policy is valuable only if dispersion-scaled hysteresis exits enough sustained adverse paths to meet strict drawdown and Calmar gates without sacrificing required upside, hiding losses in terminal inventory or concentrating gains in one year or episode.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: One frozen low-cost screen either produces a historical candidate for independent OOS or closes the exact CCI14 symmetric 75/100/125 family before optimization or runtime work consumes capacity.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The completed-day CCI14 positive-100 enter and negative-100 exit state improves after-cost risk-adjusted performance versus matched full-capital buy-and-hold in both Design and historical Validation, with stable symmetric 75 and 125 neighbors and broad annual support.
